name: io.github.sshnevis/exiryab-mcp
title: ExirYab
description: Official read-only ExirYab: find Iranian doctors by name, city and specialty, with clinics and maps.

environmentVariables.name: EXIRYAB_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for every request. System proxy settings are ignored.

environmentVariables.name: EXIRYAB_MCP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL (default https://exiryab.com), e.g. a local ExirYab for development.
